calibration.coordinate_errors: Assumed ranges; no coordinate ground truth available

spec.hypothesis: Missing player robustness lost by joint training can be recovered by restoring the legacy raw player-slot-dropout mechanism without changing architecture, labels or update budget.
spec.mechanism: Control: clean/coarse-ball views plus 25% whole-window ball-gap replacement. Slot-dropout: same first view; second coarse-ball view and its gap alternative also mask 25% of each team slots per continuous block, retaining at least five per team. Recompute all features from each raw view. Exactly half the training records carry dropout; same H/A swaps and window choices.
spec.training: Player-only D factorized shared-weight bidirectional GRU hidden24; 8 epochs; AdamW .001/.0001; batch64; clipping1; 5Hz; 10s core +5s context on each side; equal provider/match mass; training-only normalization; seeds2026/2027.
spec.primary: Equal-provider official spell F1; exact ties macro F1; report fixed auxiliary .7 spell + .3 macro.
spec.guardrails: Both seeds: clean spell >= archived current recipe +.01; each provider clean D/macro >= baseline -.02; stress spell >= baseline -.01. Also report paired augmentation-control deltas and whether clean spell loss exceeds .01.
spec.budget: 12 fits (2 arms x2 seeds x3 full-pipeline provider holdouts), 60 new match/view/arm/seed evaluations. Freeze all before scoring; no extra arms, early stopping, decoder/threshold tuning, seed selection or public scoring.
